Introducing Saved Views, available today on all paid plans. Saved Views lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so you never have to rebuild a list from scratch. Set up a view once for your sprint backlog, your overdue tasks, or your team's weekly priorities, and it's there whenever you need it.

Every user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize views by project, client, or workflow stage. Need your team to see things the same way you do? Views can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters on their own.

Whether you're managing a single project or juggling many, Saved Views helps keep your workspace organized and consistent across the board. It's a small change that saves real time every day, and we think it'll quickly become part of how your team works.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
